scenes.title: 01  INPUT
scenes.narration: Crosscheck solves English crosswords from a sample, a JSON file, or a picture.

scenes.title: 02  REVIEW THE TRANSCRIPTION
scenes.narration: For pictures, it extracts the grid and clues. The user reviews and corrects the transcription before solving.

scenes.title: 03  PROPOSE AND CHECK
scenes.narration: Nebius G L M proposes answers. Python checks their lengths and crossing letters, then searches for a compatible grid.

scenes.title: 04  OBSERVE AND REPAIR
scenes.narration: The controller revisits blocked clues when needed. Calls, time, and search work are bounded, with partial results on failure.

scenes.title: 05  MEASURE AGAINST ANSWER KEYS
scenes.narration: All six small test puzzles matched separate answer keys, but the simple baseline tied. Broader accuracy remains unproven.

scenes.title: 06  SEPARATE RESPONSIBILITIES
scenes.narration: The code separates the model, search, controller, interface, and evaluation. Ninety five offline tests pass, including repair and cancellation.
